NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed twice, but only reworded and shortened the commit subject. The code is unchanged (+17/-6 in the same 2 files).

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Subject is now under 72 characters. |
| ❌  | Subject still breaks the style guide: no space after `web:`, the text after the prefix isn't capitalized, and there's no trailing period. |
| ❌  | The commit has no body explaining what changed and why, which the guide asks for. |
| ℹ️  | The code, the tooltip behavior and the testing notes are unchanged. Once the commit message is fixed, this can go to review. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to fix the commit message.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating it! The commit message still doesn't follow our [commit message guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages). The subject needs a space after the colon, a capitalized first word, and a final period, and the commit needs a short body explaining the reasoning. Please compare it against the examples in the guide line by line before pushing again.
```
